description: Source code for a firmware image tagging utility, including functions for CRC calculation, file handling, and generating firmware tags with metadata.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line utility, parses arguments, validates input, and calls tagfile.

methods.name: tagfile
methods.description: Creates a firmware image tag with metadata, handles file I/O, CRC calculations, and tag construction.

methods.name: compute_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified file segment.

methods.name: int2tag
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to network byte order and stores it in a tag field.

methods.name: getlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a file.
